title: InfiniGen: Efficient Generative Inference of Large Language Models with Dynamic KV Cache Management
authors: Wonbeom Lee; Jungi Lee; Junghwan Seo; Jaewoong Sim
venue_full: USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation

problem_statement.en: The enormous memory footprint of the KV cache in LLM inference scales with sequence length and batch size, creating a performance bottleneck when offloading to CPU memory due to limited PCIe bandwidth. Existing KV cache eviction methods suffer from accuracy degradation and lack scalability for long-text generation.
problem_statement.zh: LLM 推理中 KV cache 的記憶體佔用隨序列長度與 batch size 線性增長，在受限 PCIe 頻寬下卸載至 CPU 記憶體時形成效能瓶頸。現有 KV cache eviction 方法存在精度下降問題，且難以擴展至長文本生成場景。

key_innovation.en: InfiniGen, a dynamic KV cache management framework that uses minimal rehearsal of attention computation to speculate and prefetch only essential KV cache entries from CPU memory, combined with offline weight skewing to improve speculation precision.
key_innovation.zh: InfiniGen 是一個動態 KV cache 管理框架，透過對 attention 計算進行輕量推演（minimal rehearsal），預測並僅從 CPU 記憶體中預取必要的 KV cache 項目；同時結合離線權重偏移（offline weight skewing）以提升推測精度。

baselines_compared: FlexGen, CUDA Unified Virtual Memory (UVM), H2O, Quantization

key_improvements.en: Up to 3.00x speedup over prior KV cache management methods and up to 32.6 percentage point increase in accuracy.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於先前 KV cache 管理方法，速度最高提升 3.00x，準確率最高提升 32.6 個百分點。

ai_task: LLM Serving, LLM Inference, Long-text generation
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA RTX A6000, Intel Xeon Gold 6136, DDR4-2666
